metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for product work: PRDs, user and market research, sales-call analysis, positioning, PLG, analytics tracking, CRO, design systems, and behavioural design.

plugins.name: prd-workflow
plugins.description: End-to-end PRD pipeline: draft, evaluate gaps, brainstorm real-world situations/behaviours

plugins.name: strategic-research
plugins.description: Research a market in plain language: map what people do, find the segments, estimate what they'd pay, size up competitors, and end with a one-page recommendation. Every fact is sourced; nothing is scored by guesswork. Run end-to-end with /strategic-research or call any step standalone.

plugins.name: pmm-define-and-review-positioning
plugins.description: Product positioning toolkit: guided 10-step workshop, positioning review/audit, competitive alternatives deep dive, market frame selection, and sales story builder. Run end-to-end with positioning-orchestrator or invoke any skill standalone.

plugins.name: user-research
plugins.description: Plan user interviews, analyze each participant's transcript with one sub-agent per participant (what they actually did, pains, goals, barriers, each with verbatim quotes), then synthesize answers to your research questions across participants.

plugins.name: sales-call-analysis
plugins.description: Turn sales call transcripts into pains, outcomes, objections and decision criteria (each with verbatim quotes), what it would take to convert each prospect, and hook messaging. One sub-agent per client, then cross-client roll-up tables.

plugins.name: plg-growth
plugins.description: Product-Led Growth toolkit: assess PLG readiness, decompose revenue drivers, choose acquisition models, run AARMS domain analysis (acquisition, activation, retention, monetisation, satisfaction), design growth loops, operationalize product-led sales, plan experiments, set up PLG data infrastructure, and plan org transformation. Grounded in structured problem solving (issue trees, hypothesis trees, MECE, 80/20, Minto Pyramid) and proven PLG frameworks.

plugins.name: event-tracking
plugins.description: Define, structure, and review analytics event tracking plans for any product. Four-stage pipeline: analytical use cases → event definition → tracking plan review → platform-specific formatting. Covers naming conventions, property design, user properties, firing conditions, and platform compliance for Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog, Segment, and GA4.

plugins.name: cro-engine
plugins.description: Conversion-rate-optimization reviewer: audits and improves landing pages, signup flows, paywalls, popups, onboarding, and forms against a library of CRO best-practice patterns and an expert-panel review gate.

plugins.name: design-system-master
plugins.description: Design system master: review an existing design system (coordination of colors/typography/spacing/shape/elevation, ease of working with it, cohesion), optimise one (consolidate tokens, fill gaps, or retrofit it into a product codebase as CSS variables / Tailwind / Style Dictionary), or create one from scratch as a lintable DESIGN.md. Grounded in a 74-system corpus spanning minimal dev-tools to dense financial and enterprise systems, with a complexity-calibration gate so it never naively simplifies complexity a domain legitimately needs. Orchestrated by /design-system-master or invoke review/optimize/create standalone.

plugins.name: designing-for-behaviour
plugins.description: Behavioural-design reviewer: evaluate how well a product experience (an existing codebase or an idea/PRD) drives user behaviour, adoption, and engagement. Scores three dimensions, ranks gaps, and prescribes an integrated set of fixes through four de-duplicated behavioural-science lenses (habit loop, cognitive ease, capability/results, control/autonomy) run as a parallel analyst board, plus an anti-bloat coherence review that keeps recommendations forming one strong core experience instead of a pile of bolted-on mechanisms. Grounded in Atomic Habits, Tiny Habits, Hooked, Badass, Thinking Fast and Slow, and Perceptual Control Theory. Run with /designing-for-behaviour.

plugins.name: user-story-review
plugins.description: User story reviewer: reads a PRD or backlog and returns a one-page triage — the few systemic issues that will sink the milestone, a verdict per story (ready / needs conversation / reframe / split / not a user story), and rewrites for the worst offenders. Judges whether a story is true and useful rather than whether it matches the template: catches feature requests wearing story clothes, generic actors, fake value, technical layers sliced as stories, and outcomes outside the team's control. Grounded in Fifty Quick Ideas to Improve Your User Stories. Run with /user-story-review.
